exposure: Misdiagnosis of uterine scar pregnancy after cesarean section
cohort: Seven patients with misdiagnosed uterine scar pregnancy after a previous cesarean section.
finding: A combined treatment approach involving active bilateral uterine artery embolization, mifepristone, methotrexate, and subsequent ultrasound-guided curettage can effectively manage misdiagnosed uterine scar pregnancy, leading to positive outcomes and full patient recovery.
mod_finding: The study focuses on uterine scar pregnancy, a serious complication that specifically arises after a cesarean section.
